t: You're looking at Figurehead, a sculpture by Rick Kirby. Kirby is a British artist, born in 1952 in Gillingham, Kent. He started out as an art teacher and left it after sixteen years to focus on his own work. Much of what he makes is figures, reflecting his interest in the human face and form, and he works mostly in steel. He says steel gives a scale and what he calls a whoom-factor that other materials can't. Look at how the steel shapes the face.
